title: How to knit gloves - step by step tutorial (plus special technique for the thumb)
description:
►A step-by-step tutorial on how to knit gloves with fingers and on double-pointed knitting needles. A simple knitting pattern that you can easily adjust to your size. Get the pattern on my blog: https://nimble-needles.com/patterns/how-to-knit-gloves/

Materials:
DK weight yarn (80-100g; for laceweight you'd only need around 50g). I am using a pure merino DK weight yarn by Samelin Dyeworks: https://bit.ly/2OiwBEE
My dpns: https://amzn.to/3fPNi4c
4in dpns: https://bit.ly/3rGFTtx
Scissors: https://bit.ly/3t89Qmk
Tapestry needle (blunt & sharp), stitch markers, a measuring tape, and a crochet hook

*Note: As an Etsy & Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

Knitted gloves are one of the most popular winter garments to knit but they are also not exactly the easiest project. Especially the gap between around the thumb is prone to creating holes, and many knitters have problems with picking up stitches for the fingers as well. This tutorial on how to knit gloves is meant to solve all these problems. Appart from showing you how to adjust your size, I also put an emphasis on getting neater results with many little tips and tricks for intermediate to advanced knitters.
This glove knitting pattern is based on double-pointed knitting needles. The cuff and the palm could be finished with circular needles or the magic loop technique, though.

German twisted cast-on: https://nimble-needles.com/stitches/how-to-do-the-german-twisted-cast-on/
Longtail purl cast-on: https://nimble-needles.com/stitches/how-to-knit-the-longtail-purl-cast-on/


Chapters:
0:00 Introduction to this glove knitting tutorial
0:48 Materials you need for knitting gloves
1:53 How to figure out your size / cast-on
4:34 Knitting the cuff of the glove
11:34 How to knit the thumb gusset of a glove
20:20 Closing the gap after the thumb gusset
24:53 Knitting the pinky finger
34:26 Picking up stitches for the ring finger
42:09 How to knit the thumb
47:08 Optional thumb mini-gusset
50:44 Finishing techniques
54:05 Last tips for knitting gloves
